manifestsWithoutConnector.filesystem: Not a @nimbus-dev/connectors connector. mesh.ts spawns @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem through bunx with no network entry.

readwise.reason: Ships as the signed extension com.nimbus.readwise (connector-catalog.ts), so its list is its own nimbus.extension.json, enforced through the run grant.

workday.reason: Per-tenant only. ensureWorkdayMcp falls through manifestForFirstParty's default-deny and adds the host of NIMBUS_WORKDAY_TENANT_HOST.

literalGaps.reason: The project link inside the User-Agent header value.
An OAuth scope string sent to the token endpoint, never fetched.

Called only by the bot send, which needs bot credentials that only chatopsTeamsBotServers injects. That spawn adds this host; the regular Microsoft bundle spawn has no bot credentials and never calls it.

knownUnreachable.reason: gha_run_log follows GitHub's redirect to a signed log URL on purpose. GitHub's runner docs give only this wildcard, the list has no wildcards, and an Azure-wide suffix would be the wrong grant anyway. Where hosts are enforced, gha_run_log fails; every other tool works.

onedrive_item_download fetches Graph's /content, which redirects to a per-tenant pre-authenticated URL. The tenant is unknown at spawn. Where hosts are enforced, this one tool fails; listing and metadata work.

CalDAV discovery returns a per-account partition host, and the connector's own manifest names only p01 to p10. An account on a higher partition loses calendar tools where hosts are enforced. Mail is unaffected unless calendar.login() itself fails, since server.ts awaits it at boot with no catch.

knownUnreachable.hosts: <region>-run.googleapis.com for a region other than the stored gcp.region
knownUnreachable.reason: The Cloud Run tools take the region as a tool argument, so the host is chosen per call. Only a stored gcp.region is declared; with none stored, or for another region, those tools fail where hosts are enforced.
gcp_gke_workload_restart runs kubectl against the address get-credentials writes, which is known only per cluster and usually a bare IP. This tool fails where hosts are enforced.

knownUnreachable.hosts: <region>-aiplatform.googleapis.com for a region other than the spawn region
knownUnreachable.reason: A tool argument may override VERTEX_AI_REGION. Only the spawn region is declared.

knownUnreachable.hosts: ecs, lambda, ec2 and sts at <region>.amazonaws.com, with no region stored
knownUnreachable.reason: A profile with no aws.default_region has no region at spawn, so nothing regional can be declared and the tools fail where hosts are enforced. Local auth adoption stores the profile's region when it has one, so this needs a profile with no region or a hand-set profile. An SSO profile's portal.sso.<sso_region> hosts are never declared.
Same bound as aws: no aws.default_region means no regional host at spawn.
Same bound as aws: no aws.default_region means no regional host at spawn.

az follows the cloud the owner set in its own config, which the gateway does not read. Only the public cloud is declared.

knownUnreachable.hosts: the cluster API server named in the kubeconfig
knownUnreachable.reason: The list is empty and no spawn site adds the server, so the policy is no-network on every OS already: kubectl tools cannot reach a cluster through the MCP connector. This forwarder changes nothing here. The gateway's own kubernetes-sync runs kubectl outside this sandbox.

knownUnreachable.hosts: registry.terraform.io, provider and backend hosts, api.pulumi.com, cloudformation.<region>.amazonaws.com
knownUnreachable.reason: The list is empty, so the policy is no-network already, and the hosts depend on each workspace's own configuration. This forwarder changes nothing here.

apple.reaches: caldav.icloud.com, then a p##-caldav.icloud.com partition; imap.mail.me.com:993 and smtp.mail.me.com:587.
apple.decision: IMAP and SMTP are added by ensureAppleMcp. Partitions p01 to p10 added to the fixed list, matching the connector's own nimbus.extension.json. Higher partitions are in knownUnreachable.

athena.reaches: aws CLI to athena.<region>.amazonaws.com; sts for credentials.
athena.decision: Endpoint prefix read from the CLI's botocore service model. Service host and regional STS are added at spawn from aws.default_region.

aws.reaches: aws CLI to ecs, lambda and ec2 at <region>.amazonaws.com; sts for an assume-role profile.
aws.decision: Every tool is a regional call and the fixed list named none of them, so the connector would have failed outright. Regional hosts are now added at spawn. The fixed list's iam, s3, ec2 and cloudfront hosts are not called by any tool; left in place and reported.

azure.reaches: az CLI to management.azure.com; login.microsoftonline.com for tokens.
azure.decision: Both are declared. az webapp and az aks nodepool are ARM calls. az telemetry to other hosts is out of process and does not fail the command. Not run against a live tenant.

Cloud Run's reference says v1 requires locational endpoints; gcloud is not installed here, so no live run confirmed the exact hosts. serviceusage rests on recalled gcloud run deploy behaviour, not on a source read here.
